title: Your first HTML document
body:
## Your first HTML document Start every page with a doctype and an `html` root. ```html My first page

Hello, Academy

This is a paragraph of text.

Learn more ``` ### Rules of thumb - One `

` per page for the main title. - Nest lists and sections logically. - Always set `lang` on `` for accessibility. ### Exercise Create `index.html` with your name as the `

` and a short bio paragraph.
